turns.message: Create a donut chart for the operational volume of each hospital, based on the number of patients with a bill exceeding 30.
turns.resolved_question: What is the operational volume of each hospital, based on the number of patients with a bill exceeding 30?
turns.reply: Answered with a read-only query (3 rows). A donut isn't offered for this result: it counts distinct values per group, so the same item can appear in several groups and the slices would not add up to a whole. It is shown as vertical bars; horizontal bars also available.
sql:
SELECT d.hospital_branch, COUNT(DISTINCT b.patient_id) AS operational_volume
FROM billing AS b
JOIN treatments AS t ON b.treatment_id = t.treatment_id
JOIN appointments AS a ON t.appointment_id = a.appointment_id
JOIN doctors AS d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id
WHERE b.amount > 30
GROUP BY d.hospital_branch
ORDER BY d.hospital_branch;
